market_specific_notes: Los Angeles claim shoppers usually need a cleaner way to compare firm fit, fee structure, and early case-handling process instead of relying on slogans or ad spend.
In Los Angeles, the strongest first-screen comparison is whether a firm explains case screening, evidence preservation, and communication cadence in plain English.
local_vetting_points: Ask what facts make the case worth a consultation now, not just whether the firm wants a lead.
Ask who manages communication after intake and how often updates are expected.
Ask how photos, treatment records, witness information, and insurance documents should be preserved immediately.
typical_cost_ranges: Most personal-injury consultations are framed around contingency economics, but the real comparison is how case costs, medical records costs, experts, and lien handling are explained.
You should compare fee language and expense treatment line by line before signing, not just headline no-fee marketing.
payment_options: Ask whether the fee is contingency-based, whether litigation expenses are advanced, and whether costs come out before or after the fee calculation.
If the firm uses medical funding or lien relationships, ask how that affects settlement math.
wait_time_notes: Speed matters most at the beginning because evidence, treatment records, scene photos, and insurance notices can get harder to organize later.
A same-day callback is less important than getting clear preservation steps and a real screening conversation.
availability_notes: Availability should be judged by whether the team can review the facts quickly and tell you what to gather next, not just by how fast intake answers the phone.
Ask whether weekends, after-hours intake, or bilingual staff are available if timing is urgent.
named_resources_or_providers: Los Angeles-area court and county filing information, bar-status lookup tools, and insurer claim-routing resources are more useful than generic lawyer directories.
Public state-bar status tools and local court information should be checked before you rely on marketing language.
city_intro_override: Los Angeles personal injury shoppers usually do better when they compare firms by screening clarity, fee language, and evidence process instead of broad promises.

primary_city_decision_block.title: Los Angeles personal injury vetting checklist
items: Compare screening clarity, fee language, and early evidence steps before comparing slogans.
Use the same shortlist questions for every firm so the comparison stays fair.
Check bar status and ask what documents should be preserved now.

case_screening_notes: Ask what facts, injuries, treatment, photos, witnesses, or insurance information make the claim consultation-ready.
Do not confuse aggressive marketing with an honest case screen.
fee_structure_notes: Ask how contingency fees, case expenses, lien handling, and settlement deductions are explained before signing.
The right question is not just what percentage — it is how the money flow is documented.
trial_readiness_notes: Ask whether the firm actually prepares cases for filing and trial if liability or damages are disputed.
Trial posture matters more when the facts are messy, not less.
local_statute_notes: Timing still matters even when the claim seems obvious, so the safest move is to ask what should be preserved immediately and what deadlines may govern the case.
